description: A PEM banner has the same prefix as a private-key block and is not the block. The two negatives use an exact banner to recognise a serialisation format, including the misskey `.includes()` shape that produced the measured false finding. The positive is a complete private key written into the source and proves that recognising a marker does not weaken the underlying key rule.

expected.note: the complete PEM block remains reportable; only a banner proven to be used as a format-test operand is silent
